name: Karl Kling
features: fair skin, light brown hair swept straight back, light eyes, broad heavy-jawed face, thickset build, genial confident smile
bio: Won the 1952 Carrera Panamericana with Hans Klenk in a 300 SL, the result that convinced Stuttgart racing was worth the money. A Mercedes works driver in 1954 and 1955 — second at Reims on his Grand Prix debut, third at Aintree, eleven starts and seventeen points. His 300 SLR crashed out of the 1955 Mille Miglia near Rome. He took over from Alfred Neubauer as head of Mercedes motorsport in 1956 and ran it until 1968, winning the Algiers-Bangui-Algiers rally himself in a 220 SE in 1961.
